title: Understanding OLS and MSE
text: Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) is a method used to estimate the parameters in a linear regression model. The goal is to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE), which measures the average of the squares of the errors between the observed and predicted values.

title: Exploring the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix, denoted as X, contains the features or independent variables of the dataset. Each row represents an observation, and each column represents a feature.

title: Linear Dependence in Features
text: If one or more features in the design matrix X are linear combinations of other features, it can lead to issues in estimating the parameters accurately. This is known as multicollinearity.
